package.author: OnlyXianzo
package.description: Privacy-first high-performance media extractor for audio and video.

en-US.author: OnlyXianzo
en-US.description: Privacy-first high-performance media extractor for audio and video.
en-US.longDescription:
Grablytic is a modern cross-platform media downloader powered by yt-dlp,
featuring fluid Flutter UI, zero telemetry, and multi-format extraction.
en-US.name: Grablytic
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- docs: publish AGENTS.md and reusable agent skills by @OnlyXianzo in #14
- Harden teardown network boundaries by @OnlyXianzo in #15
- fix: resolve the 61-finding nuclear code-quality review (engine, app, Android, CI) by @OnlyXianzo in #16
- docs: publish project vault and align typography by @OnlyXianzo in #17
- docs(readme) + fix: second-pass review findings, broad-catch ratchet by @OnlyXianzo in #18
- fix: cancelled batch items reach the engine, expired retries stop, schema v8 for existing installs by @OnlyXianzo in #19
- perf: close the third-pass residuals and its seven findings by @OnlyXianzo in #20
- Pass 4: the engine stops starting itself (#91–#98) by @OnlyXianzo in #21
- Skeleton loaders, pre-scaled logo assets, faster share start by @OnlyXianzo in #22
- ci: add CI Log Digest workflow (readable failure cause from the checks API) by @OnlyXianzo in #23
- ci(digest): '/ci-digest ' slash command for the log digest by @OnlyXianzo in #24
- ci(digest): self-diagnosing log fetch (and a push escape hatch) by @OnlyXianzo in #25
- ci(digest): strip ANSI, allow escape sequences, publish the tail by @OnlyXianzo in #26
- ci(digest): anchor the report on the step's own ##[error] marker by @OnlyXianzo in #27
- ci(digest): anchor the report on the step's own ##[error] marker by @OnlyXianzo in #28
- fix(engine): bound download file names in bytes (Errno 36 on long titles) by @OnlyXianzo in #30
- Polish Library and download history UI by @OnlyXianzo in #31
- Improve privacy-conscious crash and bug reporting by @OnlyXianzo in #32
- Capture crashes that were never opted into, and stop reporting from blocking shutdown by @OnlyXianzo in #35
- Close five scrubbing and logging gaps the last pass found by @OnlyXianzo in #36
- Reports: fix the $1 artefact, one version source, and stop dropping unsent crashes (v0.6.0) by @OnlyXianzo in #37
- release: v0.0.6 by @OnlyXianzo in #38
